description: AI Builder Summary Flow — Federal Earnings Fraud (V1 earnint solution). Reads case + related records from Dataverse, builds a structured prompt, calls AI Builder Text Generation, parses the JSON response, and writes back to earnint_ fields on the incident record. Import this blueprint into Power Automate manually.
name: EarnInt AI Case Summary
_architecture_note: Power Automate does not support multiple trigger types in a single flow. Build TWO separate flows using the same action steps (01-09): (1) EarnInt AI Summary - Auto: trigger = 'When a row is added, modified or deleted' on incident. (2) EarnInt AI Summary - Manual: trigger = 'For a selected row' on incident, which creates the ribbon button. Optionally add a third flow with an HTTP Request trigger to support the web resource Refresh button.

For_a_selected_row_manual._note: This trigger appears as 'Run AI Analysis' in the Case record ribbon after the Flow is saved.

01_Get_Case_Row.description: Fetch the full incident record including all earnint_ fields.

02_List_Discrepancy_Rows.description: Get all earnings discrepancy child records for this case.

03_List_Evidence_Items.description: Get all evidence items linked to this case.

04_List_Investigation_Findings.description: Get all investigation findings for this case.

05_Compose_Prompt.description: Build the structured prompt string to send to AI Builder.

06_AI_Builder_Text_Generation.description: Call AI Builder GPT-based text generation with the composed prompt.
06_AI_Builder_Text_Generation._setup_note: In the Power Automate designer: Add 'Create text with GPT using a prompt' (AI Builder connector). Set the prompt to the output of step 05_Compose_Prompt.

07_Compose_Raw_JSON_Payload.description: Capture the full AI Builder response as raw JSON for storage.

08a_Strip_Markdown_Fences.description: Strip markdown code fences that AI Builder sometimes wraps around the JSON output. Run this before Parse JSON.
08a_Strip_Markdown_Fences._note: In the designer: Add a Compose action. Expression: replace(replace(body('AI_Builder_text_generation')?['text'], '```json', ''), '```', '')

08b_Parse_AI_JSON_Output.description: Parse the cleaned AI Builder text as JSON to extract the three output fields. Uses output of 08a not 06.

09_Update_Case_Row.description: Write all four AI fields back to the incident record.

setup_instructions.step_1_create_flow: Go to make.powerautomate.com. Create a new Automated cloud flow. Choose trigger: 'When a row is added, modified or deleted' (Dataverse). Table: Cases (incident). Set scope to Organization.
setup_instructions.step_2_build_three_flows: BUILD THREE SEPARATE FLOWS (same action steps 01-09 in each): Flow A 'EarnInt AI Summary - Auto' with Dataverse 'When a row is added/modified/deleted' trigger on incident. Flow B 'EarnInt AI Summary - Manual' with Dataverse 'For a selected row' trigger on incident (creates ribbon button in D365). Flow C 'EarnInt AI Summary - HTTP' with 'When an HTTP request is received' trigger (body schema: {incidentId: string}) — used by the web resource Refresh button.
setup_instructions.step_3_add_actions: Add the 10 actions (01 through 09, including 08a) in sequence. Use Dataverse connector for steps 01-04 and 09. Use AI Builder connector for step 06. Use built-in Compose for 05, 07, 08a. Use built-in Parse JSON for 08b.
setup_instructions.step_4_ai_builder_setup: For step 06: Add 'Create text with GPT using a prompt' from the AI Builder connector. Paste the dynamic content output of step 05 into the prompt field. Ensure AI Builder credits are provisioned in the Power Platform environment.
setup_instructions.step_5_get_http_trigger_url: After saving Flow C, expand the 'When an HTTP request is received' trigger step — the URL appears there. Copy it and paste into the FLOW_HTTP_TRIGGER_URL constant in fraud-ai-insights.html, then re-run 70-build-web-resources.ps1.
setup_instructions.step_6_solution_import: Add all three Flows to the earnint solution: Solutions > earnint > Add existing > Automation > Cloud Flow. Select all three.
setup_instructions.ai_builder_prompt_notes: Step 08a strips markdown code fences that GPT sometimes adds. If the model still returns invalid JSON, add a Condition before 08b: if first character is '{' skip stripping, else apply replace. The prompt in 05 already instructs the model to return raw JSON only.
